      "observations": [
        "All ten owned paths and all 1,114 historical diff lines were read. Complete affected message-property/folder tasks, column task, six newly skipped adapter tasks, four grouped tasks and two threaded tasks were read with their actual local listener helpers. The three similarly named invalidation wait methods exist in their distinct helpers; no name-only API mismatch is claimed.",
        "The native listener keeps one growing JS array, a start cursor and total count. After an async result batch it notifies when unsent rows meet or exceed mail.panorama.liveViewChunkSize, default 45. Because the check is after the result-set loop, 45 is a threshold, not an exact callback size. The callback receives the accumulated array plus inclusive absolute start/end indices. Successful completion flushes the remainder and resolves that same array; cancel/error completion rejects before the final flush.",
        "selectMessages removes limit/offset and requests cancellation of a pending selection. Both top-level and in-group queries share mPendingStmt, but the in-group listener is constructed with nullptr, so it does not emit OnSelectedChunk despite the broader IDL comment. The statement cancellation and completion pointer clearing are static paths; no overlap/cancellation race was reproduced or ruled out.",
        "The adapter pre-sizes its top-level row map from countMessages, starts selection, and fills exactly the reported absolute index range. It temporarily aliases _flatRowCache to _rowMap, sets row setSize/posInSet/liveView, and invalidates that range. Threaded/grouped adapters inherit this delivery and specialize row creation. Child loading remains a Promise-based selectMessagesInGroup path. The loop index is the contract here, not an interchangeable forEach style choice.",
        "The owned patch makes onMessageAdded/onMessageRemoved empty, removes the old sparse on-demand LiveViewRowMap, changes row text computation to a lazy getter, and no longer clears the live-view listener on detach. Accepted source later restores update callbacks, makes sortBy async and clears the matching listener. Existing focused cleanup and current no-pagination interface lessons are reused as later context, not credited as original functionality.",
        "Actual accepted Panorama DOM uses auto-tree-view and imports a class extending selecting TreeView. Its inherited selecting view setter detaches the old adapter and creates a TreeSelection for the new one. B's exact whole setter record is reused only after that receiver check. Current invalidation reads view.rowCount and updates buffered display; no rendered, accessibility or perceived-speed measurement was made.",
        "The patch moves SQLite cache_size=-200000 from new-database creation to the general EnsureConnection path, so it is requested for reopened connections as well. No cache-memory, IO or performance measurement follows from this static configuration change.",
        "The patch removes direct limit/offset assertions, skips message-property selection and six date/subject cache/add-remove tasks, and changes setup waits from rowCountChanged to range invalidation. Grouped/threaded assertions still describe ordering, child expansion and collapse; these are direct source assertions, not fresh passed tests. Many assertions in the affected tasks and listener helpers omit expected-behavior messages; existing expect/test names/comments do not provide those messages.",
        "The original setTree comment promises reference cleanup, but the owned implementation only drops _liveView and caches without clearListener. The fixed accepted implementation's clearListener(this) supplies a later correction. Native early returns on cancellation/error keep completion flow explicit; threshold and inclusive-range comments remain scope-specific. No new global callback, threading, array or accessibility rule is inferred.",
        "Full primary Bug 1941471 original acc5c6edf3faa3bb4abcc21072b67dad902522b5c9fac5ede56fb64ecbed1812 is reused with its complete current0–51/activity/footer scope and exact raw-record digest. A's prior full4463 retained-body read is durable; only the relevant incremental/add-remove/cleanup phase comments were revisited now. No new raw copy, browser confirmation or second primary-read credit is claimed.",
        "The meta comment29 expressly admits breakage and reports perceived-speed improvement; comment30 describes later add/remove restoration without thread/group ordering, followed by separate ordering and cleanup patches. Actual owned empty callbacks and skipped tests match the limited initial phase; accepted restored callbacks/identity-aware cleanup are later source, not original completeness.",
        "D284022 full creation-to-final timeline and all five actual bodies were read from C3's registered original. The author calls the retained comparator code currently unused after row-change removal, attributes only a slight speed change to lazy text, and merely considers removing a development marker later. Source confirms retained comparators under a scoped no-unused-vars exception, lazy texts and marker presence. No speed or profiling measurement was made.",
        "The friend-class placement thread is explicitly personal and provisional: reviewer says he dislikes friends but does not consider placement important while lacking the full architecture view. Actual friend declaration remains. Acceptance/Done does not establish a prohibition, required private-section grouping or complete database architecture.",
        "Early historical build failures, later remote completion and landing stay distinct from current source and direct test assertions. Parent D283995/Bug2017764 and linked logs/other patch bodies are bounded dependencies; no query, screen fill, keyboard, native database, a11y or test ran."
